title: Observation recorder finalisation repair
details: Replaces the two previous recorder recovery layers with one finalisation layer to avoid them interfering with each other
If Android misses the MediaRecorder stop event, Milos releases the buffered clip after 1.2 seconds and continues
If WebM duration repair stalls on an incomplete Android recording, Milos now falls back to the original recorded blob instead of remaining on Saving clip
Unexpected camera stops still keep the buffered clip available so a judgement can be selected and the LO can be finished
Review, calendar, QR, mileage, course and existing observation records are unchanged
